name: Roblox Studio MCP server
summary: Built-in MCP server in Roblox Studio that lets AI clients explore the data model, read and edit scripts, run Luau, generate assets and playtest.
description: Runs as a local process using stdio transport against your open Studio session. Tools include script_read, multi_edit, script_search, script_grep, generate_mesh, generate_material, generate_procedural_model, search_asset and insert_asset. It replaces Roblox's standalone studio-rust-mcp-server (MIT), which is archived and no longer actively developed.
